items.description:
Zebbies Lighting Polokwane is a home-lighting and electrical retailer in Baobab Gardens, part of the national Zebbies chain. The store stocks ceiling lights, table and standing lamps, outdoor lighting, LED lighting, and ceiling and wall fans, together with the globes, bulbs and fittings that go with them, giving shoppers a single lighting range to work through.

It serves homeowners, renovators and decorators fitting out a new build or refreshing an existing room, as well as businesses sourcing lighting for commercial premises. Shoppers can browse by light category or by room, from pendant and chandelier lighting to solar and string lights for outdoor entertaining spaces. The store trades from 37 Clivicola Street in Baobab Gardens, Thornhill Estate, and suits anyone planning a lighting project from a single fitting through to a full home renovation.

items.reason: Chain branch. Further research confirms the Thornhill branch's location but found no sufficiently detailed current service list for this specific branch; the 3@1 national store-locator and Facebook page still give no branch-specific services beyond the address. Kept deferred.

items.description:
Arabela Legacy Lodge, also known as Makhadzi Cloud Lodge, is a guesthouse in Dalmada, about 14 km from the Polokwane Game Reserve. It is set in a garden with an outdoor swimming pool, and its rooms are air-conditioned, with free private parking on site.

Guests can ask for an iron and ironing board when needed, and they may bring their own ready-made food, which suits travellers who want to self-cater. Staff speak English, Xhosa and Zulu, and guests who want to change their checkout time can ask reception, though a fee may apply. The lodge is at Plot 21 Dalmada Road, a practical base for visitors who want a garden stay close to the Game Reserve and the city.

Asian Cuisine Nirvana is a halal Indian restaurant in Nirvana, Polokwane, known for North Indian-style dishes made without pork or alcohol. Its menu includes vegetarian options alongside its meat dishes, so diners keeping to a vegetarian diet or halal requirements can both be accommodated at the same table.

The restaurant offers dine-in seating, takeaway and delivery, and customers can book a table in advance rather than simply walking in. It suits families, couples and groups looking for a sit-down Indian meal as well as diners who prefer to collect or have food delivered. The restaurant trades from 101 Rajkot Avenue in Polokwane, and its combination of halal certification and vegetarian choices makes it a practical stop for diners with specific dietary needs.

items.description:
Cell C is a South African mobile network operator with a retail store in Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane. The store sells cellular products and services, including SIM starter packs, contracts, prepaid deals and mobile devices, giving shoppers a place to sign up, upgrade or get support in person rather than online.

It serves mobile customers across Polokwane who want hands-on help choosing a network deal or device, alongside shoppers already in the mall for other errands. The store trades alongside the other mobile and electronics outlets inside Mall of the North, on the corner of the R81 and N1 Bypass in Bendor. It is a convenient option for anyone wanting to compare cellular packages or sort out a mobile account face to face.

Crystal Coffee Shop on Marshall Street in Polokwane Central is a coffee shop that hosts bridal and baby showers, small weddings and functions, and business lunches. The shop specialises in cakes for all occasions, and it has an on-site hair and beauty salon, so visitors can combine a coffee with a treatment.

Customers can order with roadside or in-store collection, and the business says it aims to turn special moments into beautiful memories. Its Facebook page has more than 2,000 followers and lists the shop as a place for functions as well as everyday coffee. The shop suits families planning a baby shower, a small wedding or a business lunch in the city centre.

Dada's World of Hardware is a hardware and building-materials retailer on Genl. Joubert Street in Polokwane Central. The store's own slogan sums up what it offers: "We don't only sell hardware, we build homes," and its stock runs from general hardware and building materials through to plumbing, electrical and DIY supplies for jobs big and small.

It serves homeowners tackling a weekend repair, renovators and builders stocking up for a bigger job, and contractors who need materials for commercial and residential projects. Customers can expect the breadth of stock of an established Polokwane hardware supplier rather than a narrow specialist range. The store trades from 73 Genl. Joubert Street in Polokwane Central, and welcomes homeowners, tradespeople and businesses needing building supplies without having to travel out of the CBD.

Dalmada Storage offers secure self-storage units, storage containers and shaded parking at its premises in Dalmada, Polokwane. The business says it provides safe, reliable and affordable storage for individuals, families and businesses, and it also hires out shipping containers.

Short-term storage during a move, long-term business storage and secure parking for vehicles, trailers, caravans and equipment are all offered. The company says it has built a reputation over many years for trusted security, excellent service and customer satisfaction. Its facility is kept clean, well maintained and professionally managed, and the business has served Polokwane's storage needs for more than 10 years from Plot 36/1, Dalmada.

Inside Seshego Circle on Ditlou Street, Debonairs Pizza Seshego Circle serves the Seshego community's share of the chain's pizza menu. The line-up stretches from the Triple-Decker range, piled with extra layers of topping, to the more affordable Real Deal pizzas, alongside sides, for anyone wanting a meal that goes further without the extra cost.

Orders can be placed for collection at the counter or through Debonairs' own online ordering for delivery, so customers can eat in, grab a pizza on the way home, or have one brought to the door. The Seshego Circle branch gives families, groups and individuals in Seshego and the wider Polokwane area a nearby pizza option without a trip into the city centre, whether the order is for one person's dinner or a shared family meal.

Diamond Incorporated is a law firm in Bendor, Polokwane, that provides a wide range of legal services and handles High Court and Magistrate's Court litigation. The firm's fields include personal injury claims, corporate and commercial law, and business rescue matters.

The firm describes its team as experienced and says it aims to give clients sound advice and the best service possible. The practice was established in 1976, according to its listing, and it serves individuals and companies that need advice across most areas of law. The website says the firm can assist with all aspects of the law and has ample experience in the fields it lists. Its office is at 2a Pierre Street in Bendor, Polokwane.

items.description:
EVN Africa is a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy in Polokwane Central, with fields that include water supply, regional planning, townships, sanitation, structural and agricultural engineering, and roads. Its services include civil, structural, water and sanitation design, and roads and infrastructure design.

The company says it is also active in project and construction management, and its associated companies cover electrical engineering and environmental services. Its work runs from pre-site appraisal through to construction monitoring, so clients can keep one consultant on a project from start to finish. The website lists its fields of specialisation and group companies in one place, so prospective clients can see the disciplines it covers. The office is at 30 Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central.

items.reason: Current Seshego Circle branch status, assortment and facilities could not be sufficiently confirmed; searches for the name return only unrelated parked-domain pages, not a genuine store page. Kept deferred.

items.description:
FILA trades from Shop U02 in Mall of the North, Bendor, as part of the sportswear brand's South African retail network. The store carries FILA's athletic clothing, trainers and other footwear, and sports-fashion accessories, covering both performance wear for training and casual lifestyle pieces built around the brand's retro styling.

It serves shoppers looking for branded sportswear and footwear, from people buying gym and running kit to those after FILA's fashion-led sneakers and apparel. Being inside Mall of the North puts the store alongside the centre's other fashion and sports retailers on the corner of the N1 and R81 in Bendor, making it an easy stop for shoppers comparing sportswear brands under one roof while they are already at the mall.

Florapark Comprehensive High School is a public secondary school in Flora Park, offering CAPS-aligned schooling from the Senior Phase in Grades 8 and 9 through the FET phase to matric in Grade 12. The school's website describes a new site with a school mobile app and a digital library available to learners.

Matric learners can use the Grade 12 resources section, which includes past papers, study guides and examination guides, along with information on bursaries and a university brochure. The school credits its educators for the hard work they put in every day, and it shares its events, such as a 2025 gala dinner, in a gallery of photos. The school is at 244 Suid Street in Flora Park.

Georeen Guest House is a nine-room guesthouse in Sterpark, Polokwane, with en-suite rooms that are individually decorated. Guests can relax by the outdoor swimming pool or in the garden, and a daily breakfast is served in the dining area. The website includes a gallery of the rooms and grounds, so visitors can see the garden and pool before they book.

The guesthouse says it takes pride in its warm welcome, service and hospitality, and its owner greets guests personally as a friendly hostess. The findmy listing says the house offers good value for money, which suits visitors who want a comfortable base in Polokwane. The guesthouse is at 8 Regulus Avenue in Sterpark.

Goldwagen Polokwane supplies vehicle replacement parts and components from its premises on Tagore Street in Nirvana, as part of the national Goldwagen auto-parts chain. The branch is listed as both an auto parts store and an auto body parts supplier, giving customers a single stop for spares across most makes and models.

It serves vehicle owners and motorists needing parts for a repair, as well as mechanics and automotive repair businesses sourcing components for customers' vehicles. Walk-in customers can get a quote on the parts they need rather than ordering sight unseen. The branch trades from 204 Tagore Street in Nirvana, Polokwane, and suits anyone from a DIY motorist doing their own repair to a workshop restocking for several jobs at once.

Greener Tidings Garden Centre, inside The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, is a plant nursery and landscaping specialist. It offers plants, pots, garden accessories and garden decor, along with professional landscaping and waterwise planting advice.

The centre says it was awarded best garden centre in South Africa, and it reports first place for best inspirational displays, second place for its food gardening department and third place for best staff. Its website describes knowledgeable staff and a wide variety of plants, and the centre aims to give Polokwane gardeners the best advice at hand. The centre is at 2 Knottrox Avenue, Bendor Extension 115.

items.description:
KFC Mankweng Paledi Mall is a quick-service restaurant inside Paledi Mall, serving the chain's fried-chicken meals and fast-food menu to the Mankweng community. Orders can be placed over the counter for eating in or taking away, giving shoppers already at the mall a fast meal option without having to leave the centre.

The branch serves shoppers, families and local residents in Mankweng looking for a quick, familiar meal between errands. It sits among the other food outlets at Paledi Mall on the corner of the R71 and Main Road, making it a convenient stop for anyone wanting fast food while already at the mall rather than planning a special trip.

Lebowakgomo Post Office is a branch of the South African Post Office trading from Shop 13 in the Mapudi Phasha Complex, on the R579 (Jane Furse Road) in Lebowakgomo. Alongside standard postal counters for sending and collecting mail and parcels, the branch also offers a motor-vehicle licensing service, so residents can renew a vehicle licence disc at the same counter used for post.

It serves residents and businesses across Lebowakgomo and the surrounding area who need postal, parcel or vehicle-licensing services without travelling to a larger centre. As a rented outlet inside the shopping complex, it also gives people doing other shopping at Mapudi Phasha Complex a reason to combine errands while they are there. The branch forms part of the post office's wider counter network for tracking parcels and managing postal accounts.

Limpopo Corobrik Factory is a clay-brick and masonry-product manufacturing facility on the R71 Tzaneen Road in Dalmada, Polokwane, forming part of the Corobrik manufacturing network that supplies the building industry across South Africa. As a production site rather than a retail showroom, it supports the supply chain that puts Corobrik materials into the hands of the building trade in Limpopo and beyond.

It serves building contractors, property developers, builders and architects who specify or order Corobrik materials for their projects, as well as construction-material suppliers who stock the brand for resale. Customers with pricing or product queries are typically directed to Corobrik's established distributor network rather than buying directly at the factory gate. The Dalmada site is one of several Corobrik production facilities operating across South Africa.

The Limpopo Department of Health is the provincial government department responsible for administering and delivering public healthcare across Limpopo. From its head office on College Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, it handles provincial healthcare planning and administration, runs public-health programmes, and oversees the hospitals, clinics and other public healthcare facilities operating throughout the province.

It serves the residents of Limpopo who rely on public healthcare services, as well as the public healthcare facilities and the staff working within them, who look to the department for policy direction, resourcing and administrative support. Members of the public dealing with the department can expect to be directed to the relevant division, whether the matter concerns a provincial health programme, a facility-specific issue, or an administrative enquiry such as a vacancy or tender. The office is at 18 College Street, Hospital Park, Polokwane.

M n M Guesthouse offers seven individually decorated guestrooms near the University of Limpopo and Paledi Mall in Mankweng, with free Wi-Fi, free parking and a 24-hour front desk. Each stay includes a cooked breakfast, and the guesthouse says it offers a clean and crisp environment for guests travelling for business or leisure.

The business runs two guesthouses, one in Polokwane Central and one in Turfloop, Mankweng. Its motto is Mi casa es su casa, and staff speak English, Xhosa, Zulu and Afrikaans and can point guests to the places to visit around Polokwane. The Mankweng guesthouse is at 1338 Mamadimo Park on the R71.

Madithapa Sandblasting & Painting is a family-owned painting contractor that has served the Polokwane area for more than 20 years. The company describes itself as dedicated to preserving the life of physical assets with high-quality paints and durable coatings, and it offers sandblasting alongside painting.

Its work covers residential, commercial and government painting contracts of any size, and client testimonials on its website praise the attention to detail, professionalism and workmanship. Consultation on how a project comes together is also part of the service, and its testimonials come from construction companies and property developers it has worked with on several projects. The business is based at Plot 12 in Roodepoort, Polokwane.

items.description:
Mavuna & Netshimbupfe Inc is a law firm in Polokwane established in 2020, which describes itself as a 100% black women-owned firm. The firm lists a broad range of practice areas, including conveyancing, notarial services, deceased estates, divorce and family law, labour law and property law.

Its areas also include commercial and company law, wills and trusts, Road Accident Fund claims, debt collection, and litigation in the High Court and the Magistrates' Court. Clients can use the firm for general legal advice across these fields. The listing also includes company registrations, notarial work and partnership agreements among its practice areas, and the office is at 28A Bodenstein Street in Polokwane.

Meason Construction & Maintenance has operated since 2007, offering construction for commercial and residential buildings, along with plumbing, carpentry, electrical and solar work. The company describes itself as trading across Limpopo, the Western Cape and the Eastern Cape. Its electrical team has experience installing, repairing and maintaining systems linked to the solar industry.

Its maintenance services include waterproofing for external walls, facades and roofs, including roof rubber and other acrylic roof solutions, and it also builds, repairs and treats roofs and thatch structures. The business is a preferred service provider for several major insurance companies, according to its listing. Its Polokwane Central office is at 68A Hoog Street.

items.description:
Mošatê Lodge is a four-star accommodation and conference venue on the corner of Grobler and Dorp Streets in Hospital Park, Polokwane. The lodge describes its rooms as beautifully appointed and designed for relaxation, and it offers a serene retreat for guests visiting for business or leisure.

For business travellers, the lodge has conferencing facilities for meetings and events, and its website lets visitors view the rooms, host a conference or make a reservation directly. The lodge presents itself as a home away from home in Limpopo, which makes it a practical choice for visitors who want four-star comfort and professional conference facilities in one place.

items.description:
Nando's Polokwane CBD is a flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken restaurant on Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central, close to the CBD tennis courts and Peter Mokaba Stadium. The restaurant serves Portuguese-inspired chicken, and it is open for dine-in, collection and delivery. The listing describes a spacious dining room.

The branch lists Wi-Fi, an alcohol licence and a generator among its amenities. Other Nando's branches at Savannah Mall, Mall of the North, Paledi Mall and Thornhill are listed as nearby options for customers who want to eat at another location. The branch is at 60 Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central. Its page has separate call, delivery and collection links, so customers can order ahead or get in touch with the restaurant directly.

items.description:
Nguni Grill is a family restaurant and bar on Morris Street in Bendor, Polokwane, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. Its menu covers an exceptional range of steaks, burgers, ribs, pizza and other specialty dishes, and the restaurant says it offers great service, great food and great value.

The bar serves cocktails and beer, and the restaurant takes reservations by phone for a preferred party size and time. The business has served Polokwane since 2009, and its menu includes breakfast, burgers, steaks, sushi and grill platters. The restaurant is at 28 Morris Street in Bendor. Its website has a gallery and a feedback form, so diners can share how the food and service went.

items.description:
Pietersburg Vet Clinic is a veterinary practice in Polokwane Ext 6, providing veterinary healthcare to animals from its premises on Marshall Street. The practice is an established part of Polokwane's veterinary services, with trading information confirming it as an active, operating clinic rather than a seasonal or part-time practice.

It serves pet owners bringing in dogs, cats and other companion animals, as well as owners of other animals, including horses, who need veterinary attention. Clients have described staff following up personally after a visit to check on an animal's recovery, a level of care that matters to owners dealing with an injured or unwell pet. The clinic is at 217 Marshall Street, Polokwane Ext 6, and gives Polokwane pet and animal owners a local practice to turn to when veterinary care is needed.

Plumber Polokwane is a plumbing service in Polokwane Central that offers residential and commercial plumbing to people across Polokwane and the surrounding areas. Its services include geyser installation and repair for electric, gas and solar geysers, blocked drains, leak detection and water tank installation.

The team also handles emergency plumbing, general plumbing, water meter installation and general maintenance, with emergency callouts for urgent faults. The business presents itself as affordable and reliable, and it invites customers to call for a quote before work starts. Its website lists leak detection and blocked drains alongside geyser work, so one plumber covers the main household jobs. The office is at Unit 12, 51 Biccard Street in Polokwane Central.

Pratt Luyt & De Lange is one of the oldest established law firms in Polokwane, with a history dating back to 1908. The firm serves companies, individuals, financial institutions and government, and it says it provides tailor-made solutions across different fields of law.

Its practice covers conveyancing, commercial law, litigation and deceased estates, and the firm says it is recognised for its professionalism and its ability to assist clients. Its staff undergo ongoing training, which the firm says keeps the team fast and efficient, and it says its commitment to clients is rooted in both its professional and administrative staff. The office is at 20 Watermelon Street in Bendor Park.
